application: Access control / animal ID / old car immobilisers
typical_devices: EM4100/EM4200 proximity card (Flipper Zero RFID read/emulate); HID Prox card (26-bit Wiegand); AWID card; Indala card; FDX-B animal microchip (ISO 11784/11785); TIRIS RFID (Texas Instruments); Pyramid Series readers (HID); Paxton Net2 reader (125 kHz older models); ACM-1000/ACM-500 reader; ProxMark3 (clone/attack tool)
modulation: ASK/FSK; Manchester/Biphase/PSK encoding depending on protocol
power_limit: LF reader field: 42 dBμA/m at 10m typical
regulatory_ref: ISO 11784/11785 (FDX-B animal); HID Wiegand de-facto standard; ETSI EN 300 330
notes: EM4100: 64-bit read-only ID, Manchester encoding, 125 kHz. HID Prox: proprietary encoding, 26-bit Wiegand output. IMPORTANT: Flipper Zero can READ and EMULATE most 125 kHz cards (EM4100, HID Prox, Indala). ProxMark3: full attack capability (read/write/emulate/brute-force). Security note: most 125 kHz systems have NO crypto — trivially cloneable.
